description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330016565681 PACKING,PREFORMED: Line 0001 Qty 82 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
